craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of containment — the Vijñānavāda opponent staged at full strength, then held; śāstra-hammer couplets, negation-anaphora, terminal doctrine words. The turn + ring: as before echoes v1s grant — no-difference now swallows bare awareness. Slowest line; sting is cold/śānta. Rejected: (a) heightening (how terrible) → killed: heat is imported vighna. (b) resolving aparāmarśa past ungrasping → killed by frozen ledger. Read aloud: AND-were a-WARE-ness UN-grasp-ING … AS-be-FORE.

lines: And were awareness ungrasping in its very form,
it too would rank with non-being, with the inert — as before.
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃvid apy aparāmarśarūpā cet tad asāv api abhāvena jaḍenātha tulyaiva prāgvad ātmani

reads_against.argmap: Does bare, ungrasping awareness escape? → The turn: grasp-less light is inert; only self-reflective awareness can ground.
c1_essence: Every candidate seat of distinction — predicates, objecthood, conceded difference, free-standing being, function — collapses into knower-dependence; the opponent's no-difference is granted, then outflanked from inside (vv1-8).
Grasping-less awareness is declared inert, and the proof turns: only self-reflective consciousness can stand as ground (v9).
